# Commands

Every command, by what you use it for. Each page lists all options, generated from the command line.

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## Finding papers

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`mosaic search`](./search) | Search for papers across all configured sources. |
| [`mosaic similar`](./similar) | Find papers similar to a given paper by DOI or arXiv ID. |
| [`mosaic watch`](./watch) | Saved searches that report only papers new since the last run. |
| [`mosaic cite`](./cite) | Format and print a citation for a paper by DOI. |

## Getting PDFs

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`mosaic get`](./get) | Download a paper by DOI, or bulk-download all DOIs from a .bib/.csv file. |
| [`mosaic import`](./import) | Move PDFs you downloaded yourself into the library, named and recorded like `get`. |
| [`mosaic auth`](./auth) | Manage browser sessions for authenticated PDF access. |

## Your library

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`mosaic cache`](./cache) | Inspect and manage the local SQLite cache. |
| [`mosaic index`](./index-command) | Build or update the vector index for semantic search and RAG. |
| [`mosaic ask`](./ask) | Ask a question about your cached papers using RAG. |
| [`mosaic chat`](./chat) | Interactive RAG chat session over your cached papers. |
| [`mosaic compare`](./compare) | Compare a set of papers across structured dimensions using an LLM. |
| [`mosaic network`](./network) | Analyse the local citation network and visualise paper clusters. |

## Elsewhere

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`mosaic ui`](./ui) | Launch the MOSAIC web interface. |
| [`mosaic notebook`](./notebook) | Create and populate Google NotebookLM notebooks from search results. |
| [`mosaic skill`](./skill) | Manage the bundled MOSAIC Claude Code skill. |

## Setup

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`mosaic config`](./config) | View or update MOSAIC configuration. |

## Global options

Put them before the command: `mosaic --verbose search ...`.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version`, `-v` |  |  | Show version and exit |
| `--verbose` |  |  | Show warnings and per-source stats |
| `--install-completion` |  |  | Install completion for the current shell. |
| `--show-completion` |  |  | Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation. |
<!-- cli:end -->
